lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with inter-centroid distance increasing towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges running horizontally across the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side.
